name: 473. A unified speech field a provider has mapped reaches the vendor once, never again as a raw extra param (speech mapped extra params) [SERIAL]
description: TXE-7077. The speech route parses language_code, pronunciation_dictionary_locators, enable_logging, optimize_streaming_latency, with_timestamps and max_output_tokens into the typed request and also leaves them among the extra params. Every row sends x-bf-passthrough-extra-params: true, so the extra params are merged into the vendor body. A provider that maps the field to the vendor's own name, a query parameter or the endpoint must not also send the copy. Each row reads from the fixture's /__wire what the vendor received. A vendor-specific extra param in the same request still arrives, so the rows fail on a provider that stops forwarding extra params altogether.

item.name: 473.1 sarvam/bulbul:v2 /v1/audio/speech language_code reaches Sarvam as target_language_code only, and the vendor field pitch still arrives (speech mapped extra params)

exec: if (pm.variables.get('providerErrorFixture') !== '1') {
pm.execution.skipRequest();
pm.sendRequest({ url: pm.variables.get('providerErrorFixtureUrl') + '/__reset', method: 'POST' }, function (err, res) {
pm.test('speech mapped extra params setup: the fixture was reset', function () {
pm.expect(err, String(err)).to.equal(null);
pm.expect(res.code).to.equal(200);
var FX = pm.variables.get('providerErrorFixtureUrl');
// sent: the one request that reached the fixture under prefix, bytes and query as they arrived.

function sent(prefix, cb) { pm.sendRequest({ url: FX + '/__wire', method: 'GET' }, function (err, res) { pm.test('the fixture answered /__wire', function () { pm.expect(err, String(err)).to.equal(null); pm.expect(res.code).to.equal(200); }); var calls = res.json().data[0].calls.filter(function (c) { return c.path.indexOf(prefix) === 0; }); pm.test('exactly one upstream call', function () { pm.expect(calls, JSON.stringify(res.json().data[0].calls)).to.have.length(1); }); if (calls.length === 1) { cb(calls[0], JSON.parse(calls[0].body)); } }); }
pm.test('the client gets 200', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.equal(200); });
sent('/pp/sarvam/text-to-speech', function (call, body) {
pm.test('language_code is sent as target_language_code', function () { pm.expect(body.target_language_code, call.body).to.equal('hi-IN'); });
pm.test('the body has no language_code field', function () { pm.expect(body, call.body).to.not.have.property('language_code'); });
pm.test('the vendor field pitch arrives', function () { pm.expect(body.pitch, call.body).to.equal(0.2); });
